# hostd_ip_set_member (Resource)

One address or network in a firewall IP set. IPv4 up to `/24`, IPv6 up to `/64`. Changing `project_id`, `ip_set_id` or `cidr` replaces the member. Import with `<project_id>,<ip_set_id>,<cidr>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hostd_ip_set_member" "office" {
  project_id = hostd_ip_set.office.project_id
  ip_set_id  = hostd_ip_set.office.id
  cidr       = "203.0.113.10"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cidr` (String) IPv4 or IPv6 address or CIDR. An IPv4 network can be no larger than `/24`, an IPv6 network no larger than `/64`.
- `ip_set_id` (String) UUID of the IP set (`hostd_ip_set`).
- `project_id` (String) UUID of the project the IP set belongs to.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Free-text comment. Empty by default.
- `nomatch` (Boolean) When true, the entry is excluded from the set instead of included.
